paper_record.title: Gauss Law, Monodromy Defect, Magnetic Lattice Translation, and Lattice Duality
paper_record.abstract: In a Hamiltonian lattice gauge theory, the physical Hilbert space is fixed by the Gauss law, by choosing an eigenspace of the Gauss law operator which generates the gauge transformation. Choosing a non-trivial eigenspace is referred to as the modified Gauss law. In 2+1d dynamical U(1) pure gauge theory, we show that these physical Hilbert spaces are defect Hilbert spaces associated with non-topological monodromy defects for monopole operators and topological defects for U(1) 1-form symmetry, inserted along the time direction. We also construct the corresponding lattice translation operators. Under a nontrivially modified Gauss law, these translations obey a magnetic translation algebra. Finally, we discuss how the modified Gauss laws are manifested in 2+1d compact bosons, via exact duality on the lattice.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文研究了2+1维U(1)晶格规范理论中修改高斯定律的物理意义，将其解释为单值缺陷和拓扑缺陷的插入，并构建了相应的磁平移算符。
one_sentence_summary.en: This paper investigates the physical interpretation of modified Gauss laws in 2+1d U(1) lattice gauge theory, identifying them as insertions of monodromy and topological defects, and constructs the corresponding magnetic translation operators.

problem.zh: 在哈密顿晶格规范理论中，修改高斯定律（即选择非平凡本征空间）对应的物理Hilbert空间及其物理意义尚不明确。
problem.en: The physical interpretation and the nature of the Hilbert spaces associated with modified Gauss laws (choosing non-trivial eigenspaces) in Hamiltonian lattice gauge theory remain unclear.

approach.zh: 通过分析U(1)规范理论的模空间，将修改的高斯定律与单值缺陷（monodromy defects）和拓扑缺陷联系起来，并利用晶格平移算符的代数结构进行验证。
approach.en: By analyzing the moduli space of U(1) gauge theory, the authors relate modified Gauss laws to monodromy and topological defects, and verify this through the algebraic structure of lattice translation operators.

main_takeaway.zh: 修改后的高斯定律对应于在时空方向插入单值缺陷和拓扑缺陷，且在非平凡修改下，晶格平移算符满足磁平移代数。
main_takeaway.en: Modified Gauss laws correspond to the insertion of monodromy and topological defects along the time direction, and under non-trivial modifications, lattice translation operators satisfy a magnetic translation algebra.

why_it_matters.zh: 该工作深化了对晶格规范理论中约束条件与缺陷之间关系的理解，为研究规范理论的对称性及对偶性提供了新的视角。
why_it_matters.en: This work deepens the understanding of the relationship between constraints and defects in lattice gauge theory, providing new insights into the symmetries and dualities of gauge theories.

reason.zh: 文章清晰地阐明了修改高斯定律与缺陷插入之间的对应关系，并统一了相关物理图像。
reason.en: The paper clearly clarifies the correspondence between modified Gauss laws and defect insertions, unifying the associated physical picture.

reason.zh: 该领域（广义对称性、晶格规范理论）的典型高水平投稿期刊。
reason.en: A typical high-level journal for this field (generalized symmetries, lattice gauge theory).
